name: BG3 Modded
description: Baldur's Gate 3 mod snapshot with modsettings and Script Extender

notes.title: Close Baldur's Gate 3 before installing
notes.body: The pack writes mods and modsettings into the game's Proton prefix. Close the game and its launcher first.

notes.title: Saves
notes.body: Saves are not part of the pack and are not synced. Adding or removing mods can affect existing saves.

preconditions.title: Proton prefix exists
preconditions.hint: Launch the vanilla game once from Steam.

preconditions.title: Enough space to apply the pack
